page: Microsoft Azure NC40ads_H100_v5 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCadsH100v5 family. It features 40 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9V84 processor running at 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 320.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB per core, and a bundled NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU with 94 GB of VRAM. For local storage, the instance provides 3971 GB of local disk capacity and is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates strong performance across multiple domains. Multi-core CPU performance via Geekbench ranks in the top tier, while single-core performance falls in the top 25%. Memory performance is highly rated, with the Passmark memory score reaching the top 10% and cached read-only small block memory bandwidth placing in the top 25%. For specialized workloads, image processing benchmarks score in the top 10%, and LLM text generation speeds reach 286.08 tokens/second for a 135M model and 33.22 tokens/second for a 7B model, both placing in the top 25%.

Given the inclusion of a dedicated NVIDIA H100 GPU and a high-density AMD EPYC processor, this server represents a high-resource hardware class. The qualitative cost efficiency is optimized for workloads requiring massive parallel processing and high-speed local storage, though the large-block uncached memory read bandwidth and static web serving throughput perform at average levels. The dedicated core allocation ensures consistent execution without resource contention.

This server is designed for demanding workloads such as large language model inference, machine learning training, image processing, ray tracing, and high-performance database operations. The combination of dedicated AMD EPYC cores, high-capacity local storage, and Hopper GPU acceleration makes it suitable for data science, deep learning, and complex scientific simulations.
